name: When should I consider replacing my pool tiles?

mainEntity.name: When should I consider replacing my pool tiles?

acceptedAnswer.text: You should consider replacing your pool tiles if you notice signs of extensive wear and tear, such as cracking, chipping, or widespread discoloration. Loose or missing tiles can also indicate a need for replacement, as they can lead to structural damage or make the pool unsafe. Beyond functional issues, a tile replacement is a good opportunity to update your pool's aesthetic. If you're undertaking a major pool renovation or want to refresh your outdoor living space, custom tile installation can significantly enhance its overall appeal and value.
acceptedAnswer.description: Replace pool tiles if you see cracking, chipping, widespread discoloration, or loose tiles. It's also an opportunity to update your pool's aesthetic during renovation.
